text:
jess: Heads-up: after upgrading the JS SDK in the expo sample, Metro fails to bundle (missing node core libs) and the auth flow gets stuck in retries. Anyone hit this combo?

sam: paste the Metro error?

jess: "Unable to resolve module 'stream' from 'node_modules/redwood-sdk/dist/index.js'". Full snippet points at our bundled commonjs output.

kevin: Metro + Node core is expected. Two pragmatic fixes: 1) add mappings in metro.config.extraNodeModules to RN-friendly packages (readable-stream, buffer, react-native-quick-crypto), or 2) ship an ESM/browser build that avoids node core imports.

maria: FYI for randomness on RN you need `react-native-get-random-values` at app entry. Without it some auth code that uses crypto.getRandomValues falls back and fails.

jess: I tried extraNodeModules and import of get-random-values. Bundle succeeded, but login returns 401 and the SDK retries forever: logs show "[auth] request failed 401 -> retrying (attempt 4)" repeatedly.

sam: Oh — SDK retry semantics are too broad: currently any non-2xx gets treated as retriable. That's incorrect for 401/403. We should only retry on network errors and server 5xx.

sam: Proposed minimal change: if (status === 401 || status === 403) throw AuthError and do not schedule a retry; only apply retry logic for status >=500 or for fetch/network exceptions. Also add an option `retryOnAuthError: boolean` default false.

kevin: +1. Also expose hook to inspect raw response body for quicker debugging (enterprise folks need the error details).

maria: Another gotcha: TypeScript types reference DOM globals like ReadableStream and Blob which RN TS projects don't have. The sample hits `Cannot find name 'ReadableStream'`. Workarounds: include a small `global.d.ts` in sample app with `declare type ReadableStream = any; declare var Blob: any;` and document it. Adding `dom` to tsconfig breaks other RN types.

jess: I'll open a PR that: (A) updates the Expo sample README with a short RN onboarding checklist (metro.extraNodeModules snippet, install react-native-get-random-values and react-native-quick-crypto), (B) adds global.d.ts to the sample app, and (C) patches SDK retry logic to skip retries for 401/403 and expose `retryOnAuthError` config.

ci-bot: Created issue #5398: "expo sample: polyfills, types, and auth retry fix" and attached logs.

sam: Quick test plan for PR: repro with outdated SDK -> confirm bundle error; after patch confirm bundle works, login returns 401 surfaced with no retry; simulate 502 and confirm retries still happen. Also test both dev and production metro bundles.

jess: Thanks — I'll land a small change and tag you for review. Short note added to the README about removing global.d.ts in web builds. :rocket:
